pairs.subject: import-normalization
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-types/src/catalog.rs:72 The crate only declares the product's own wire and package formats (situations.json, character.toml v2, RPC/event types, all specified in docs/spec/contract.md). That is the golden path's 'you control both ends' exclusion. A search of crates/shadowrunr-types for foreign, fingerprint, lossy, loss_ledger and detect_format found nothing; 'import' matches only 'importance' in memory.rs. So no foreign-format detection, adapter, IR or loss ledger lives here.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-types/src/catalog.rs:72 There is one parse type per in-house format with a fixed spec, so there is no set of candidate foreign formats to fingerprint.

crates/shadowrunr-types/src/character.rs:209 This is an in-house config override layered on engine defaults, not an import overlay of foreign material. Absence semantics are stated here, but the import precondition does not hold.
crates/shadowrunr-types/src/catalog.rs:144 This is a digest-guarded write of an owned package document, not consent to an import of foreign entities.
